definitions.explanation: The act of producing and distributing books, magazines, or other written materials.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{小説|しょうせつ}を{出版|しゅっぱん}した。
{彼|かれ}は{出版|しゅっぱん}{社|しゃ}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: He works at a publishing company.

examples.japanese: {電子|でんし}{書籍|しょせき}の{普及|ふきゅう}により、{出版|しゅっぱん}{業界|ぎょうかい}は{大|おお}きく{変|か}わった。{紙|かみ}の{本|ほん}の{売|う}り{上|あ}げは{減|へ}っているが、{新|あたら}しいビジネスモデルも{生|う}まれている。
examples.english: The publishing industry has changed significantly with the spread of e-books. While paper book sales are declining, new business models are also emerging.

notes:
{出版|しゅっぱん} refers to publishing or publication of books and other written materials.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {出版|しゅっぱん}する (to publish)
- {出版|しゅっぱん}される (to be published)
- ○○を{出版|しゅっぱん}する (to publish XX)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出版|しゅっぱん}{社|しゃ} (publishing company)
- {出版|しゅっぱん}{業|ぎょう} (publishing industry)
- {出版|しゅっぱん}{物|ぶつ} (publication, published work)
- {出版|しゅっぱん}{日|び} (publication date)
- {自費|じひ}{出版|しゅっぱん} (self-publishing)
- {電子|でんし}{出版|しゅっぱん} (electronic publishing)

RELATED TERMS:
- {発行|はっこう}: issuance, publication (broader - includes newspapers, stamps)
- {刊行|かんこう}: publication (more formal, literary)
